verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes sandbox lifecycle, snapshots, volumes, networking, and SDKs, but contains no documentation about data retention policies, deletion controls, data export, or how long sandbox/snapshot data persists or how a user can delete it beyond normal sandbox teardown. No privacy/retention policy page or deletion API is cited. Missing for 10: explicit data retention policy documentation, user-facing deletion/export controls, and any statement on how long data or logs are retained or how to purge them.
